items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: he's my girl friend's husband. They live out in California. We all came up together.

ctx.x: I'll let him go through it and get all the dates. It's all back there somewhere, the date he went with Louis Armstrong, Fletcher Henderson. But I do know he came to New York. Chick Webb heard him, you know, and he went to play with Chick Webb, played the Savoy. I hadn't seen him for years and Edgar Hayes's wife and I was coming down Seventh Avenue. You know that was Harlem.
Could you tell us a little bit about it?
